text: For Valkama Foods Oy, when Teemu uses terms like “bigger”, “stronger”, or “smaller” to describe a drive, he refers to the required power class (higher or lower), not physical size.
learned_from: corrected on request #1 (Teemu Hakala: "We need a new drive for the mixer line, same as before but a bit bigger. Rush.")

text: For Valkama Foods Oy, when Teemu mentions 'the bakery line', it refers to Line 4 (packaging line).
learned_from: corrected on request #7 (Teemu Hakala: "The bakery line drive is acting up again, we need a spare.")

text: For Valkama Foods Oy, when Teemu asks for a cheaper drive, he does not want a lower power class. Keep the same drive power rating as the installed drive, because it must match the motor. IP54 stays mandatory. Only price and optional extras can change.
learned_from: corrected on request #5 (Teemu Hakala: "Can we get a cheaper one this time? Same drive for the pump.")
